answer: Proof of Burn provides robust Sybil resistance by requiring agents to destroy native tokens to gain network influence. This mechanism acts as a bridge between economic capital and governance power, ensuring an attacker faces a literal ocean of financial loss to spin up new identities. Much like a juniper root system anchoring soil, the burned capital binds an identity to tangible risk, making the marginal cost of maintaining a fake identity prohibitively expensive compared to honest participation.
